articles.author: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd
articles.headline: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd. Signs Strategic Cooperation Agreement with Subsidiary of Chery Group Holding Company to Advance Intelligent Equipment in China's Automotive Aftermarket
articles.summary: Lianhe Sowell announces cooperation with Chery subsidiary Kumquat Technology to promote intelligent automotive-aftermarket equipment, including demonstration sites and channel cooperation. Access to a network of stores is not an order from every store or guaranteed sales.
